The correct answer is **the friend**. The executory interest to the sister’s children who reach 25 violates the Rule Against Perpetuities because the sister was single at the time of conveyance and could have additional children beyond the perpetuities period, so that interest is void. Thus, the friend owns the lot in fee simple absolute (the granted fee simple subject to the void executory interest is treated as absolute).

CONFIDENCE: 95
